question: Does frozen history-sensitive purchasing accumulate real resources across 32 decisions in one continuously writable body?
world: Each life begins with two distinct ordinary actual contacts among six recurring objects. Each block of eight price opportunities presents the six recurring objects and two fresh unrelated targets once in a random order. Immediately before every fourth opportunity one fresh unrelated object is contacted, its actual taste is experienced, and the body keeps its state. The initial and distractor contacts are unscored environmental experience. Given one geometry and one random private base law for each object, cross a common sign flip over the recurring group with a separate common sign flip over the new-target/distractor group. Keep all public positions, gaps, prices and draws shared under the four private maps. Initial object IDs, target IDs, laws and counterfactual utilities are never given to the actor. Use the old bilateral price signal and randomized left/right ticket mark. The first two opportunities have the same independently drawn price within each geometry, so that an early matched shuffle can change the allocation.
timeline: The actor sees the current object, physically chooses the native priced ticket menu, experiences its actually incurred cost, and then acts on the ordinary review menu. Buying grants that contact's actual signed food taste. Passing delivers zero informational taste through the same menu and clock. After a gap, the actor physically chooses the harvest side. A good harvest pays 1, another harvest pays 0. The full life balance is those actual harvest gains minus real purchase costs. In the immediate environment the signed harvest taste reaches the body at harvest. The delayed environment records each harvest choice in the ledger, delivers zero taste through the ordinary observation and writing clock, and settles the signed food feedback after decision 32. After the ledger closes, the environment delivers pending signed tastes in original order using the actual earlier harvest side and fresh edit draws.
instrument: The augmented evidence and dose arms receive the fixed extra public input on the priced menu. Their six running numbers use the previous food-contact rule and receive an additive outer-product update only from actual nonzero food taste, including initial, distractor, review and any delivered harvest taste. Sum the updates from birth to the end of the life. The trained body and local writing rule stay active continuously. The evidence interface presents the query projection and the dose interface presents one third of the accumulated trace.
paired_controls: Deploy every fixed graph with its own native movement even if its training purchases were externally assigned. Score natural buying, forced always buy, forced always pass, and the same natural life’s purchase allocation randomly permuted within exact price and opportunity-stage strata. Randomize four times per life. Entire counterfactual lives replay from their own identical birth state and all later choices, receipts, writes and activations are recalculated. The random allocation uses the completed natural life retrospectively as a causal control. By construction every per-life purchase count and expenditure through 2, 8 and 32 is identical in natural and its yoked control. Empty, singleton or unanimous strata are retained.
uncertainty: Average four private maps and the four control allocations inside each geometry. Before bootstrapping pair each model with itself across routes and match independent births within each cohort. Use 4000 crossed resamples of births and common geometries, with separate resamples per cohort. Keep all worlds and contrasts, report utility, gross gains, fees and buy counts at 2, 8 and 32, and the share of decisions changed by matched randomization.
